name: Mechanics of Biological Systems
description: Scope of continuum mechanics in biological systems; refresher: statics and dynamics; refresher: mathematical preliminaries (tensor calculus); continuum description of stress, strain and linearized kinematics; equilibrium equations and their application to biological systems; generalized constitutive laws - linear elasticity (LEHI) and nonlinear behaviour; application of solid mechanics principles to biological systems - bones (axial loading), arteries/capillaries (thin walled tubes), aneurysms (thin walled spheres); hydrostatics and fluid kinematics; mass and momentum balance laws; Newtonian and non-Newtonian biological fluids (for example, blood, mucus); Navier–Stokes equations and simplified flow cases; viscoelastic behavior in soft tissues and biological gels; demonstrations of advanced topics - fluid structure interactions, wall wetting.
